note: The equipment as installed, from the labels and Solify's single-line diagram. Serial and meter numbers are kept out of this public file; they come from the SYSTEM_PRIVATE secret and are encrypted with the rest of the data.

shutdown.where: the switch on the box under the inverter

backupHeat.note: Not marked on the label; the meter and thermostat point to the 7.5 kW kit. A technician can confirm it.

outdoorUnit.heatingCapacity: Heat output falls in the cold: about 22,700 BTU/h at −8°C and 18,300 at −20°C, below which it stops (Bosch spec sheet).
